description: Election Commission - Declare that A. L. M. Ahsan as a member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member through a political party process, which falls directly under electoral processes and related administrative matters.
